changes: Commanders prioritize airfield upgrades after three rifle squads and two troop trucks. Tier 2 costs 600 SP / 60 seconds; tier 3 costs 1,200 SP / 90 seconds, with a 200 SP reserve. Starting depots remain empty.

Tier 1: one strip, one forklift, existing single delivery truck. Tier 2: one strip, two forklifts, two trucks. Tier 3: two separate strips, four forklifts, four trucks with two visible 900-unit trailers each (2,700 units per truck).

Supplies and SP income scale 1x/2x/4x. Scheduled waves deliver 3,300/6,600/13,200 resource units; tier 3 receives two concurrent 6,600-unit aircraft. Inventory moves through actual unloading, forklift handling and truck delivery.

Transport helicopters have 24 troop seats, excluding crew. Rifle squads now have four members, so six fit aboard. Assault flights require at least 12 active troops, touchdown at zero altitude and sequential unloading at one soldier per simulation second. Embarked troops never capture or contest; capture eligibility begins after unloading is complete.

All vehicle engine fuel burn doubled. Refueling and rearming rates divided by three, including infantry depot rearming. Vehicle empty-to-full service takes 60 seconds with adequate stock; repair speed is unchanged.
Logistics UI shows current tier, construction countdown, equipment capacity, income and tier costs. Models gain the second landing strip and mission-dependent double trailers.

audio_semantics.envelope: Attack and decay reach output and output*sustain; non-looping sounds hold until max(duration, attack+decay), then release. Looping sounds sustain until faded out.
audio_semantics.oscillators: Enabled waves use freq*ratio, cent detune, and endRatio pitch ramps for non-looping sounds.
audio_semantics.noise_and_filter: Shared white noise is low-pass filtered by noiseFreq, then mixed through the preset filter, normalized soft distortion and envelope.
audio_semantics.repeat_and_speed: Repeat uses sinusoidal amplitude modulation. Normalized speed interpolates pitch/filter/repeat multipliers from 1 to the specified maximum, including maxima below 1. Runtime vehicle speed input currently uses movement-state approximation.
audio_semantics.output: Preset outputs above 1 are retained; master gain and a compressor bound the mixed output. Sound-bank replacement fades existing voices and recreates loops on subsequent updates.
